items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oscar Brown, Jr., was “you.” We did that for several years with different people.

ctx.x: Oscar did what he did. I did Miss Otis. No, not Miss Otis – Just Because We’re Kids. I had on sneakers. I came out and did Just Because – this was the first time it had been done in a long – or it had been done. John put together – we were doing a little production. Just Because We’re Kids, I had a little ball and had my little short skirt on and went back to being a little kid, and when I did Guess Who I Saw Today, I sang that, and at the end of it, I turned the chair around. Oscar Brown, Jr., was “you.” We did…
But it appealed to your actress side.
